name: Product Tilt Reveal
description: A product window rises from a steep 64° lean-back to flat under a glowing bloom; its top edge catches light, a sheen crosses the glass and an issue completes during a slow push-in.
move: A product window rises from a steep 64° lean-back to flat under a glowing bloom; its top edge catches light, a sheen crosses the glass and an issue completes during a slow push-in.
how: Window in a perspective(1100px) wrapper, origin at its bottom edge; rotationX 64→0, y 120→0, scale .94→1 over 2.6s with cubic-bezier(0.3,0.05,0.12,1) so the flatten is long and even. Bottom of the shot fades out with a mask-image. Progress ring fills by stroke-dashoffset, then fattens into a disc with a check.
adapt: Replace the DOM product UI with your screens (keep the .persp/.win structure); a screenshot works too. Placeholder product names and copy are generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Timeline-driven: register the page's CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot and rebuild the timeline; state painted in onUpdate must stay a function of tl.time().
caveats: Original implementation; no third-party UI kit, product or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
